input: Find soccer, baseball and softball camps and clinics (clubs, academies, college camps) for kids and teens in the Asheville area of Western North Carolina (within about an hour of Asheville). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: soccer summer camps Asheville 2025 academy shield

candidates.name: Asheville Buncombe Youth Soccer Association (ABYSA / Highland Football Club)
candidates.note: FUNdamentals, academy and competitive soccer camps; also locations in Hendersonville, Mills River and Mars Hill.

candidates.name: Asheville Football Club
candidates.note: Four-day competitive soccer camp for boys and girls at Warren Wilson College in summer 2026.

candidates.name: UNC Asheville
candidates.note: Baseball and men's and women's soccer camps; men's soccer offered summer day camps and a July 2026 ID camp.

candidates.name: D-BAT Asheville
candidates.note: Baseball and softball summer camps plus specialty skills clinics.

candidates.name: T.C. Roberson High School
candidates.note: Youth summer sports camps, including a confirmed 2026 baseball camp.

candidates.name: Brevard College
candidates.note: Youth soccer camp in June 2026 and summer soccer ID clinics; also a baseball prospect camp in August 2025.

candidates.name: White Squirrel Baseball Academy
candidates.note: Runs Brevard Baseball Camps, with summer youth instruction and prospect showcases at Brevard College.

candidates.name: Mars Hill University
candidates.note: Summer baseball and soccer camps; coaching staffs also run baseball and softball skills and prospect camps.

candidates.name: Western Carolina University
candidates.note: Youth and prospect baseball camps; softball elite prospect instruction for ages 13+, including August 2026.

candidates.name: US Sports Camps
candidates.note: Nike baseball, softball and boys' soccer camps at Montreat College; softball serves girls ages 10–18.

candidates.name: Montreat College
candidates.note: College-run baseball skills camps and clinics; softball program offered a July 2026 prospect clinic.

candidates.name: Big League Camp
candidates.note: Five-day baseball and softball camps for ages 12–19; campers under 13 attend days only.

candidates.name: Hendersonville Honeycrisps
candidates.note: Youth baseball camps for ages 6–14 taught by collegiate players and coaches.

candidates.name: Challenger Sports
candidates.note: International soccer summer camp listed in Waynesville for 2026.

candidates.name: U.S. Baseball Academy
candidates.note: Asheville-Weaverville summer baseball camp covering hitting, pitching, fielding, baserunning and catching.

candidates.name: Real Madrid Foundation Clinics USA
candidates.note: Announced Asheville summer 2027 soccer camp for boys and girls ages 5–17.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Summer multisport day camp at Burton Street Center includes soccer alongside other sports.
